messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INC-2026-0421 PagerRelay outgoing pages to channel #sre failed — 12 attempts dropped. External API returned 403 Forbidden. Routing key: team:sre. Logs: https://logs.redwood.internal/ingress/1778881234

SRE Oncall: seeing it. I'll take primary. What's the blast radius?

Anna: Confirmed customer-facing impact — Support ticket #4219 references delayed page for a SEV. We have two on-calls who didn't get paged. Customer impact: delayed response and manual phone escalation.

Mike: any recent deploys to notify-proxy/pager-relay? I see a config push ~18m ago that rotated signing keys. Could be key mismatch.

Emma: I can start manual phone pages and SMS for current oncall if someone confirms the numbers. :phone:

Anna: Reproduced locally — calling the relay endpoint with our prod token returns 403.

Anna: ```
$ curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $PROD_PAGER_KEY" 
  https://pager-relay.redwood.net/v1/send 
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{"error":"invalid signing key","code":"signing_key_mismatch"}
```

Mike: yep that error is the signing key mismatch from the new rotation. It looks like the new key wasn't accepted by the external pager service (they rolled a stricter enforcement). The rotation job marked complete but the secret didn't rollout to the relay pods.

Eng Infra: noticed a failed secret-sync job in k8s: `secret-syncer` crashed and didn't push the updated key to the pager-relay namespace. Crash loop started after the rotation. Logs: https://logs.redwood.internal/infra/secret-syncer/1778881248

SRE Oncall: ok immediate mitigation: Emma do manual phone/SMS paging for primary oncall until we fix. Anna update the incident timeline and note manual pages. Mike, can you rollback the rotation or re-sync the secret? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Mike: starting secret re-sync now. Command: `kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/secret-syncer && kubectl -n prod rollout restart deployment/pager-relay`

Mike: Applying rollback of key rotation to previous key in Vault and triggering sync. ETA ~3m.

Anna: I'm calling the customer and support lead to acknowledge the delayed page and steps we're taking. Adding note to the ticket.

incident-bot: :information_source: Action required: manual paging in progress — incident page suppressed by bot to avoid duplicate calls. React with :thumbsup: when manual workaround complete.

Emma: Manual pages sent via Twilio + phone tree. Confirmed primary received call. :thumbsup:

Mike: secret-syncer restarted, pager-relay pods restarted, test call now returns 200.

Anna: ```
$ curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $PROD_PAGER_KEY" 
  https://pager-relay.redwood.net/v1/send 
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{"status":"queued","id":"abc123"}
```

SRE Oncall: monitoring. If pages look good for 10m we'll close the live mitigation and run postmortem. Please hold on escalation to paging vendor until after postmortem.

Mike: I'll follow up with a hotfix to add health-check gating on secret-syncer during rotations so this doesn't recur. Filing a follow-up ticket: INFRA-712.

Anna: Customer notified, incident timeline updated, manual paging noted. Closing live mitigation in 12m if no regressions. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

SRE Oncall: thanks team. Postmortem owners: Mike + Anna + Eng Infra.
